reason: The Constitution sets no term for the Speaker, so 'Until replaced' vs '3 years' (one Congress) was disputable; rewritten to how the Speaker is chosen (Art. VI Sec. 16(1)).

fields.text: Under the 1987 Constitution, how is the Speaker of the House of Representatives chosen?
fields.optionB: Elected by a majority vote of all the Members of the House
fields.optionC: Elected by the people in a nationwide vote
fields.optionD: The longest-serving Member automatically becomes Speaker
fields.explanation: Article VI, Section 16(1) of the 1987 Constitution provides that the House of Representatives elects its Speaker by a majority vote of all its Members. The Senate elects its President the same way.
fields.hint: Each chamber of Congress picks its own presiding officer.
fields.whyA: The President has no power to appoint the leaders of Congress; that would violate separation of powers.
fields.whyC: Only the President, Vice-President and senators are elected nationwide; the Speaker is chosen by fellow Members.
fields.whyD: Seniority does not decide it; the Constitution requires an election by majority vote of all Members.
fields.explanationTl: Sa Article VI, Section 16(1) ng 1987 Constitution, ang mga Members mismo ng House ang nag-e-elect ng Speaker, by majority vote of all Members. Ganun din sa Senate, sila ang pumipili ng Senate President.
fields.hintTl: Isipin mo: sino ang pumipili ng leader ng bawat chamber ng Congress?

reason: Key correct; option A sharpened to the constitutional wording and explanation now cites Art. IX-C Sec. 2(1).

fields.text: What is the main function of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC)?
fields.optionA: Enforce and administer all laws on the conduct of elections
fields.optionB: Audit the accounts of government agencies
fields.explanation: Under Article IX-C, Section 2(1) of the 1987 Constitution, the COMELEC enforces and administers all laws and regulations relating to the conduct of elections, plebiscites, initiatives, referendums and recalls.
fields.hint: The answer is in the commission's name.
fields.whyB: Auditing government accounts is the job of the Commission on Audit (Art. IX-D).
fields.whyC: Appointments belong mainly to the President; the Civil Service Commission handles the civil service, not COMELEC.
fields.whyD: Making laws is the job of Congress (Art. VI), not a constitutional commission.
fields.explanationTl: Sa Article IX-C, Section 2(1) ng 1987 Constitution, ang COMELEC ang nag-e-enforce at nag-a-administer ng lahat ng election laws, pati plebiscite, initiative, referendum at recall.
fields.hintTl: Nasa pangalan na mismo ng commission ang sagot.

reason: Key correct; explanation now cites Sec. 7(d) and notes the distractors are Sec. 4 norms of conduct.

fields.explanation: Section 7(d) of RA 6713 prohibits public officials and employees from soliciting or accepting gifts or anything of monetary value in connection with any transaction affected by the functions of their office. Political neutrality, professionalism and responsiveness are norms of conduct required under Section 4, not prohibited acts.
fields.hint: Three of the options are duties every public servant must follow.
fields.whyA: Political neutrality is a required norm of conduct under Section 4(h), not a prohibited act.
fields.whyC: Professionalism is a required norm of conduct under Section 4(b).
fields.whyD: Responsiveness to the public is a required norm of conduct under Section 4(e).
fields.explanationTl: Sa Section 7(d) ng RA 6713, bawal sa public officials at employees ang humingi o tumanggap ng regalo o anumang may halaga na konektado sa trabaho nila. Yung political neutrality, professionalism at responsiveness ay mga norms of conduct sa Section 4, ibig sabihin required yun, hindi bawal.
fields.hintTl: Tatlo sa choices ay mga dapat gawin ng public servant. Alin ang hindi?

fields.hint: It is not Canada's biggest city; it sits in the province of Ontario on the border with Quebec.
fields.whyA: Toronto is Canada's largest city, but not its capital.
fields.whyC: Vancouver is a major west-coast city in British Columbia, not the capital.
fields.whyD: Montreal is the largest city in Quebec, not the national capital.
fields.explanationTl: Ottawa ang capital ng Canada, dito nakatayo ang Parliament nila. Madalas mapagkamalan ang Toronto kasi yun ang pinakamalaking city.

reason: 'Largest country in Africa' changed in 2011 (Sudan split), a time-sensitive superlative; rewritten to a stable Africa geography fact.

fields.text: The Suez Canal, which links the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea, is located in which country?
fields.explanation: The Suez Canal runs through Egypt, connecting the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea. It opened in 1869 and lets ships travel between Europe and Asia without sailing around Africa.
fields.hint: Think of the country that lies between the Mediterranean and the Red Sea, at the corner of Africa and Asia.
fields.whyA: Sudan borders the Red Sea but not the Mediterranean, so the canal cannot be there.
fields.whyC: Libya is on the Mediterranean but has no Red Sea coast.
fields.whyD: Morocco is at the far western end of North Africa, near the Strait of Gibraltar.
fields.explanationTl: Nasa Egypt ang Suez Canal, kinokonekta nito ang Mediterranean Sea at Red Sea. Binuksan ito noong 1869, kaya hindi na kailangang umikot ng barko sa buong Africa para makarating ng Asia mula Europe.
fields.hintTl: Aling bansa ang nasa pagitan ng Mediterranean at Red Sea?

reason: Key correct; explanation said blue whales grow 'up to 100 meters' (false: about 30 m / 100 feet); fixed; difficulty set to 1.

fields.explanation: The blue whale is the largest mammal, and the largest animal known to have ever lived, reaching about 30 meters (about 100 feet) in length.
fields.hint: The biggest mammal does not live on land.
fields.whyB: The elephant is the largest LAND animal, but it is far smaller than the blue whale.
fields.whyC: The giraffe is the tallest animal, not the largest.
fields.whyD: The rhinoceros is large but smaller than both the elephant and the blue whale.
fields.explanationTl: Ang blue whale ang pinakamalaking mammal, at pinakamalaking hayop na nabuhay kailanman, umaabot ng mga 30 meters ang haba.
fields.hintTl: Hindi sa lupa nakatira ang pinakamalaking mammal.

reason: 'Father of Modern Physics' is attributed to both Galileo (most common, incl. by Einstein himself) and Einstein; keyed Einstein was disputable; rewritten to theory of relativity.

fields.text: Which scientist developed the theory of relativity?
fields.explanation: Albert Einstein developed the special theory of relativity (1905) and the general theory of relativity (1915), which changed how science understands space, time and gravity.
fields.hint: His famous equation is E = mc².
fields.whyA: Isaac Newton gave the laws of motion and universal gravitation, which relativity later refined.
fields.whyC: Galileo pioneered experiments and the telescope, centuries before relativity.
fields.whyD: Niels Bohr is known for his model of the atom and quantum theory, not relativity.
fields.explanationTl: Si Albert Einstein ang nag-develop ng theory of relativity, yung special relativity noong 1905 at general relativity noong 1915. Binago nito ang pagkaintindi natin sa space, time at gravity.
fields.hintTl: Siya yung may sikat na equation na E = mc².

fields.hintTl: Galing ang nickname sa mga Europeo na halos walang alam sa loob ng kontinenteng ito.

fields.text: Republic Act No. 9262 is also known as the:
fields.optionA: Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act of 2004
fields.explanation: RA 9262 is the Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act of 2004 (Anti-VAWC Act), which defines and penalizes violence against women and their children.
fields.hint: Its common short name is 'VAWC'.
fields.whyB: The Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act is RA 3019.

fields.explanationTl: Ang RA 9262 ay ang Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act of 2004, o mas kilala bilang Anti-VAWC Act. Pinoprotektahan nito ang mga babae at mga anak nila laban sa violence.

fields.hint: He was a German astronomer who used Tycho Brahe's observations to show that orbits are ellipses.
fields.whyA: Newton later explained WHY Kepler's laws work using his law of universal gravitation.
fields.whyC: Galileo supported the Sun-centered model with telescope observations but did not formulate the laws of planetary motion.
fields.whyD: Copernicus proposed the Sun-centered (heliocentric) model, but with circular orbits; the laws came from Kepler.
fields.explanationTl: Si Johannes Kepler ang nag-formulate ng three laws of planetary motion noong early 1600s, kasama na yung elliptical ang orbit ng mga planeta. Si Newton ang nagpaliwanag kung bakit gumagana ang mga ito gamit ang gravity.
fields.hintTl: Siya ang nagsabing ellipse, hindi perfect circle, ang orbit ng mga planeta.

reason: No law declares a national dance; Tinikling and Cariñosa are both widely cited as such, so two answers were defensible; rewritten to a stable folk-dance fact.

fields.text: Which Philippine folk dance is performed while balancing lighted oil lamps on the head and the backs of the hands?
fields.explanation: Pandanggo sa Ilaw, from Mindoro, is danced while balancing three oil lamps (tinghoy), one on the head and one on the back of each hand. 'Ilaw' means light.
fields.hint: This dance comes from Mindoro and is a version of the fandango.
fields.whyA: Tinikling is danced between two clapping bamboo poles, imitating the tikling bird.
fields.whyB: Cariñosa is a flirtatious courtship dance done with a fan and handkerchief.
fields.whyD: Singkil is a Maranao royal dance done with fans while stepping between crisscrossed bamboo poles.
fields.explanationTl: Ang Pandanggo sa Ilaw, galing Mindoro, ay sinasayaw habang may binabalanse na tatlong oil lamp o tinghoy: isa sa ulo at tig-isa sa likod ng kamay. Ang 'ilaw' ay light.
fields.hintTl: Galing Mindoro ang sayaw na ito, at version siya ng fandango.
